meta.title: Repository-side academic verification of review-pending resources
meta.scope: The three new review-pending Development resources for OCR AS Level Economics (H060) topic 2.2 (site order 4.2): study guide, revision notes and practice questions; plus two new review-pending practice pages: Cambridge IGCSE Urdu as a Second Language (0539) Component 5 Speaking practice questions, and IB DP Geography fieldwork internal assessment practice questions
meta.method: Each resource read in full and checked against the OCR AS Level Economics (H060) Version 3.0 (June 2026) specification text, section 2d (Component 2, H060/02), topic 2.2 Development, for specification identity, coverage of all four 2.2 statements, accuracy at AS level, terminology, cross-board isolation, originality and placeholders. Mark tariffs compared with marking points, following the multi-part total convention of sibling H060 practice pages. Every numerical worked example and answer recomputed in Python. Internal /resources/ links checked against existing files. Factual claims (Brundtland 1987 definition, 17 SDGs 2015-2030, UK net zero 2050, HDI dimensions and UNDP method, UK services share of output) checked against public official sources: UN, UNDP, legislation.gov.uk and ONS. No error found, so no edits were made; enrichment beyond spec wording recorded as minor open issues. The two practice pages were checked the same way. The 0539 Speaking page was read in full against the Cambridge IGCSE Urdu as a Second Language 0539 syllabus for 2025-2027 (Version 2), sections on Component 5 Speaking (structure of the Speaking test, Topics for Part 3, Speaking assessment criteria grid), for part structure, timings, marks, cue-card and illustrative-material rules and the Part 3 topic rule, with every Urdu prompt and model answer read for grammar and register; one logic error in Q3 was corrected and Urdu doubts were recorded as open issues for the Urdu specialist. The IB DP Geography fieldwork practice page was read in full against the repository fieldwork study guide, which cites only the IB subject guide (ibo.org blocks automated access, so it was not used); the Spearman's rank and chi-squared answers were recomputed in Python and the critical values (rs 0.648 for n = 10 and 0.738 for n = 8 at 5 per cent two-tailed; chi-squared 7.81 for 3 degrees of freedom) were derived exactly; IB-specific claims that no public official source could confirm are listed as unverifiable.
meta.whatThisIsNot: Not a teacher review and not a sign-off. No reviewStatus, reviewer, reviewedDate, author or publishedDate was changed. Every resource here remains review-pending until a named, authorised Marlbridge reviewer accepts it under the editorial policy.

outcomes.VERIFIED_AFTER_CORRECTION: errors found and corrected in this programme
outcomes.PARTIAL_UNVERIFIABLE: no error found, but material claims could not be checked against a public official source (typically licensed IB guide content or blocked board pages)

results.calculationsRecomputed: Test total about 10-12 min (syllabus 'approximately 10-12 minutes'); part times 2-3 + 3-4 + 3-4 = 8-11 min of speaking within it; marks 3 x 20 = 60, each part two strands of 10 with five 2-mark levels and 0 (grid). Q4 model presentation 241 words, matching 'about 250 words', 241/2.5 min = 96 words a minute. Q4 suggested headings 5 (limit 5); Q2 rewrite 5 headings. Tariffs vs marking points: Q1 5 x 1 = 5, Q2 2 + 1 = 3, Q3 3 x 1 = 3, Q5 3 x 2 = 6, Q7 4 x 1 = 4, Q8 2 + 1 = 3, Q9 3 x 1 = 3, Q4/Q6/Q10/Q11 20 each (syllabus). Part 3 area assignments checked against the syllabus topic table: Home life, School routine, Health and fitness in A; Eating out in B; Festivals, Weather, The environment in C; Careers and employment / future career plans in D; one topic from A-B and one from C-E, no overlap with the presentation.

openIssues.description: 'دس سال بعد آپ خود کو کہاں دیکھتے ہیں؟' is a calque of the English 'where do you see yourself in ten years'. It is understandable and common in modern usage; a more idiomatic option would be 'دس سال بعد آپ کیا کر رہے ہوں گے؟'. Left for the Urdu specialist.

Grammar, gender agreement (the female presentation and male replies are consistent; the 'کھینچی تھی' agreement note is correct) and register (آپ throughout, with informal یار/تم flagged in Q8) were read by a non-specialist and no clear error was found. The page's reviewNote still requires an Urdu specialist check of naturalness.

Whether the practised skills (focused question, hypotheses, sampling, pilot study, risk and ethics, presentation, Spearman's rank, chi-squared, Mann-Whitney U, evaluation) match the current IA criteria; the page states that it does not replicate the criteria, and its tariffs and 8-mark bands are a Marlbridge convention
results.calculationsRecomputed: Q8(a) ranks (largest = 1) recomputed: distance A-J = 10..1; score A10 B8 C9 D6 E5 F7 G3 H4 I1 J2; d = 0,1,-1,1,1,-2,1,-1,1,-1; sum d squared = 12; rs = 1 - 72/990 = 1 - 0.0727 = 0.9273, so 0.93. Q8(b) critical value: the exact permutation distribution for n = 10 gives 0.648 at 5 per cent two-tailed (0.564 one-tailed); P(sum d squared <= 12) = 0.00017, so the result is significant. Study guide cross-check: n = 8 critical value 0.738 exact; sum d squared 166, rs = -0.976. Q10 E = 80/4 = 20; (O - E) squared / E = 9.8, 0.2, 1.8, 5.0; total 16.8; df = 3; chi-squared critical value 7.8147 for 3 df at 0.05 (by bisection on the CDF), so 16.8 > 7.81 and the null hypothesis is rejected. Tariffs vs marking points: Q1 2 + 1 = 3, Q2 2, Q3 2, Q4 4, Q5 3, Q6 2, Q7 2 + 2 = 4, Q8 5 (ranks 2 + sum 1 + substitution 1 + answer 1) + 2 + 2, Q9 3, Q10 4, Q11 1 + 2 = 3, Q12 3, Q13 8 (bands 1-3 / 4-6 / 7-8), Q14 7 elements + 1 coherence = 8. Q13 span: 5 sites at 200 m = 800 m. Bradshaw downstream trends (width, depth, velocity up; sediment size down) checked as standard model content.

openIssues.description: The hypothesis is directional ('increases with distance'), so a one-tailed test could be argued, but the page gives the two-tailed critical value 0.648. rs = 0.93 exceeds both 0.648 and the one-tailed 0.564, so the conclusion is unaffected. Left unedited.
